advisories.title: The D-056 Class B sentence attaches a condition D-056 does not itself record
advisories.location: Decision item 2 - 'D-056 Class B remains ineligible while thresholds are UNDECIDED.'
advisories.what: D-056's text places DR-118 on a flat ineligible list - 'DR-103/104/105/114/118 and the twelve no-contract rows remain ineligible' - with no per-row reason and no expiry. The draft's 'while thresholds are UNDECIDED' is an inference presented as D-056's own term, and read strictly it implies the ineligibility lapses once thresholds are decided, which D-056 does not say.
advisories.whyOnlyAdvisory: The inference is sound on the merits, since D-056's second eligibility gate requires the remainder be only execution or measurement and DR-118's remainder is an undecided design question. More importantly the direction of error is strictly conservative: every use of the clause in this draft argues against eligibility, never for it, and the same item states plainly that Class A is not opened and no row is marked SATISFIED. I raised this same phrasing as an advisory at the contract layer (CLAUDE-V5-ADV-4) and it has carried through the lineage unchanged; it does not block a recording that grants nothing.
advisories.suggestedNotRequired: Attribute the list to D-056 and the rationale to the draft - D-056 lists DR-118 ineligible; the gate it fails is the execution-or-measurement-only gate.

advisories.title: The three advisories are recorded as travelling but no destination is named
advisories.what: Item 3 correctly records all three advisory ids and correctly states they are not SHOULD-FIX and do not block. It does not say where they travel to - the v14 successor, a not-folded booking, or a later disposition - so the forward obligation has no named owner or landing place.
advisories.whyOnlyAdvisory: The attack this generation was asked to survive is that the advisories go unrecorded, and they are recorded with exact ids, which is what preserves them. The contract lineage itself has a working mechanism for the rest - notFoldedThisSuccessor and the per-generation repair arrays - and by my v13 reading it is in good order, so the destination exists even though this draft does not name it. Nothing is lost; a reader simply has to look one artifact over.
